allowed_clients.description: List of client IP addresses or CIDRs allowed to connect. Leave empty to allow all clients.

items.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address or CIDR block (e.g., '192.168.1.0/24').

bind_address.description: IP address the daemon binds to. Use 0.0.0.0 to accept connections from any interface.

extra_init_args.description: Key–value pairs for optional PKCS#11 module initialization (e.g., PIN, slot, model-specific flags).

max_sessions.description: Maximum number of concurrent PKCS#11 sessions allowed.

pid_file.description: Path where the daemon writes its process ID file.

pkcs11_module_path.description: Absolute path to the PKCS#11 module (e.g., SoftHSM or vendor HSM library).

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum time (in seconds) to wait for PKCS#11 operations before timing out.

tls_cert_file.description: Path to TLS certificate file (PEM format). Required if TLS is enabled.

tls_enabled.description: Enable TLS encryption for client connections.

tls_key_file.description: Path to TLS private key file (PEM format). Required if TLS is enabled.

use_syslog.description: Whether to send logs to the system syslog daemon.
